verdict.rationale: Workable is a SaaS recruiting platform, so an official CLI is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence documents only a REST API, webhooks, llms.txt and an official MCP server, and none of it mentions a command-line tool. The API and MCP server are adjacent programmatic surfaces, not a CLI, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
